facts.fact: The Somali Ministry of Communication and Technology's EA-RDIP project unit sets out in its January 2026 manual a grievance mechanism whose channels will include telephone hotline, SMS and WhatsApp, email and online platforms, plus suggestion boxes, for complaints about the project; no case numbers are given.

systems.platform: hotline, SMS/WhatsApp, email, online platforms, suggestion boxes
systems.owner: Ministry of Communication and Technology, Project Implementation Unit
